# Cygnus AI Labs

> Cygnus AI Labs builds production-grade AI automation, applied intelligence, systems integration, and web development solutions that help businesses streamline operations and scale workflows.

## Organization Summary

- **Company Name**: Cygnus AI Labs
- **Website**: https://www.cygnuslabs.si/
- **Contact Email**: business@cygnuslabs.si
- **Core Focus**: AI automation for businesses, AI agents and intelligent workflows, business process automation, custom AI integrations, web development, and technical delivery.
- **Research Vision**: Long-horizon intelligence and Cygnus superintelligence as an ambitious guiding horizon for autonomous planning and safety engineering (not claiming current AGI).
- **Engagement Model**: Scoped deployments, human-in-the-loop review, and auditable production outcomes.
- **Client Data & Security**: Zero-data-retention model configurations, enterprise encryption, and no training on customer proprietary data.

## Core Disciplines & Services

1. **AI Automation (`https://www.cygnuslabs.si/services/ai-automation`)**
   - Purpose: Design and deployment of autonomous AI agents, workflow routing, document processing, and business process automation.
   - Target Audience: Teams losing hours to manual handoffs, data re-entry, and repetitive administrative bottlenecks.
   - Differentiator: Every automated process maintains human checkpoints where judgment matters, accompanied by verifiable audit trails.

2. **Applied Intelligence (`https://www.cygnuslabs.si/services/applied-intelligence`)**
   - Purpose: Decision intelligence systems, executive copilots, and analytical briefs that synthesize multi-source business data.
   - Key Feature: Auditable and explainable recommendations where outputs trace directly back to verified source inputs.
   - Benefit: Accelerates operational decision-making while keeping accountable human leaders in control.

3. **Systems Integration & Web Development (`https://www.cygnuslabs.si/services/systems-integration`)**
   - Purpose: End-to-end technical implementation and web development connecting modern AI models to existing enterprise infrastructure (ERPs, CRMs, relational databases, webhooks, and APIs).
   - Approach: Maps workflows before modifying code; connects high-impact paths incrementally rather than demanding disruptive platform rewrites.

4. **Long-Horizon Research (`https://www.cygnuslabs.si/services/long-horizon-research`)**
   - Purpose: Applied research into multi-step planning, automated evaluation, and safety oversight mechanisms.
   - Superintelligence Concept: An ambitious, long-term research vision emphasizing that advanced systems must expand human capability through sober, verifiable engineering.

## Selected Projects & Digital Work

The website features selected digital work and technical implementations organized by industry in the Signal Atlas (`https://www.cygnuslabs.si/#work`):

1. **Dental technology** — Adore Milling Solutions (`https://adore-smile.vercel.app/`)
   - Digital dental milling solutions, precision, quality, consistency, and open-system CAD/CAM integrations.

2. **Life sciences** — Integris Life Sciences (`https://integris-ls-ugs-2026.vercel.app/`)
   - Pharmaceutical formulations and healthcare products.

3. **IT and workforce solutions** — BES Info Tech Pvt Limited (`https://besinfotech.vercel.app/`)
   - IT recruitment, manpower solutions, and campus placements.

4. **Automotive commerce** — True Car Bazaar (`https://true-car-bazaar2026.vercel.app/`)
   - A pre-owned car marketplace for buying, selling, or exchanging used cars.

## Career Opportunities

- Applications and inquiries are accepted directly via email at `business@cygnuslabs.si`.
